text_en: And I have so preached this gospel , not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man a foundation.
text_la: Sic autem prædicavi Evangelium hoc, non ubi nominatus est Christus, ne super alienum fundamentum ædificarem:
text_pt: E desta maneira me esforcei por anunciar o evangelho, não onde Cristo foi nomeado, para não edificar sobre fundamento alheio;
text_el: οὕτως δὲ φιλοτιμούμενον εὐαγγελίζεσθαι οὐχ ὅπου ὠνομάσθη Χριστός, ἵνα μὴ ἐπ' ἀλλότριον θεμέλιον οἰκοδομῶ,

text_en: But as it is written: They to whom he was not spoken of shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
text_la: sed sicut scriptum est : Quibus non est annuntiatum de eo, videbunt : et qui non audierunt, intelligent.
text_pt: Antes, como está escrito:Aqueles a quem não foi anunciado, o verão,E os que não ouviram o entenderão.
text_el: ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται, ὄψονται οἷς οὐκ ἀνηγγέλη περὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ οἳ οὐκ ἀκηκόασιν συνήσουσιν.

text_en: For which cause also, I was hindered very much from coming to you and have been kept away till now.
text_la: Propter quod et impediebar plurimum venire ad vos, et prohibitus sum usque adhuc.
text_pt: Por isso também muitas vezes tenho sido impedido de ir ter convosco.
text_el: Διὸ καὶ ἐνεκοπτόμην τὰ πολλὰ τοῦ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς:

text_en: But now, having no more place in these countries and having a great desire these many years past to come unto you,
text_la: Nunc vero ulterius locum non habens in his regionibus, cupiditatem autem habens veniendi ad vos ex multis jam præcedentibus annis:
text_pt: Mas agora, que não tenho mais demora nestes sítios, e tendo já há muitos anos grande desejo de ir ter convosco,
text_el: νυνὶ δὲ μηκέτι τόπον ἔχων ἐν τοῖς κλίμασι τούτοις, ἐπιποθίαν δὲ ἔχων τοῦ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ ἱκανῶν ἐτῶν,

text_en: when I shall begin to take my journey into Spain , I hope that, as I pass, I shall see you and be brought on my way thither by you: if first, in part, I shall have enjoyed you.
text_la: cum in Hispaniam proficisci cœpero, spero quod præteriens videam vos, et a vobis deducar illuc, si vobis primum ex parte fruitus fuero.
text_pt: Quando partir para Espanha irei ter convosco; pois espero que de passagem vos verei, e que para lá seja encaminhado por vós, depois de ter gozado um pouco da vossa companhia.
text_el: ὡς ἂν πορεύωμαι εἰς τὴν Σπανίαν: ἐλπίζω γὰρ διαπορευόμενος θεάσασθαι ὑμᾶς καὶ ὑφ' ὑμῶν προπεμφθῆναι ἐκεῖ, ἐὰν ὑμῶν πρῶτον ἀπὸ μέρους ἐμπλησθῶ.

text_en: But now I shall go to Jerusalem , to minister unto the saints .
text_la: Nunc igitur proficiscar in Jerusalem ministrare sanctis.
text_pt: Mas agora vou a Jerusalém para ministrar aos santos.
text_el: νυνὶ δὲ πορεύομαι εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ διακονῶν τοῖς ἁγίοις.

text_en: For it has pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a contribution for the poor of the saints that are in Jerusalem .
text_la: Probaverunt enim Macedonia et Achaia collationem aliquam facere in pauperes sanctorum, qui sunt in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Porque pareceu bem à macedônia e à Acaia fazerem uma coleta para os pobres dentre os santos que estão em Jerusalém.
text_el: εὐδόκησαν γὰρ Μακεδονία καὶ Ἀχαΐα κοινωνίαν τινὰ ποιήσασθαι εἰς τοὺς πτωχοὺς τῶν ἁγίων τῶν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ.

text_en: For it has pleased them: and they are their debtors. For, if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they ought also in carnal things to minister to them.
text_la: Placuit enim eis : et debitores sunt eorum. Nam si spiritualium eorum participes facti sunt gentiles, debent et in carnalibus ministrare illis.
text_pt: Isto lhes pareceu bem, como devedores que são para com eles. Porque, se os gentios foram participantes dos seus bens espirituais, devem também ministrar-lhes os temporais.
text_el: εὐδόκησαν γάρ, καὶ ὀφειλέται εἰσὶν αὐτῶν: εἰ γὰρ τοῖς πνευματικοῖς αὐτῶν ἐκοινώνησαν τὰ ἔθνη, ὀφείλουσιν καὶ ἐν τοῖς σαρκικοῖς λειτουργῆσαι αὐτοῖς.

text_en: When therefore I shall have accomplished this and consigned to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain .
text_la: Hoc igitur cum consummavero, et assignavero eis fructum hunc, per vos proficiscar in Hispaniam.
text_pt: Assim que, concluído isto, e havendo-lhes consignado este fruto, de lá, passando por vós, irei à Espanha.
text_el: τοῦτο οὖν ἐπιτελέσας, καὶ σφραγισάμενος αὐτοῖς τὸν καρπὸν τοῦτον, ἀπελεύσομαι δι' ὑμῶν εἰς Σπανίαν:

text_en: And I know that when I come to you I shall come in the abundance of the blessing of the gospel of Christ .
text_la: Scio autem quoniam veniens ad vos, in abundantia benedictionis Evangelii Christi veniam.
text_pt: E bem sei que, indo ter convosco, chegarei com a plenitude da bênção do evangelho de Cristo.
text_el: οἶδα δὲ ὅτι ἐρχόμενος πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν πληρώματι εὐλογίας Χριστοῦ ἐλεύσομαι.

text_en: I beseech you therefore, brethren, through our Lord Jesus Christ and by the charity of the Holy Ghost , that you help me in your prayers for me to God ,
text_la: Obsecro ergo vos fratres per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, et per caritatem Sancti Spiritus, ut adjuvetis me in orationibus vestris pro me ad Deum,
text_pt: E rogo-vos, irmãos, por nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo e pelo amor do Espírito, que combatais comigo nas vossas orações por mim a Deus;
text_el: παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, διὰ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ διὰ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ πνεύματος, συναγωνίσασθαί μοι ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ πρὸς τὸν θεόν,

text_en: that I may be delivered from the unbelievers that are in Judea and that the oblation of my service may be acceptable in Jerusalem to the saints .
text_la: ut liberer ab infidelibus, qui sunt in Judæa, et obsequii mei oblatio accepta fiat in Jerusalem sanctis,
text_pt: Para que seja livre dos rebeldes que estão na Judéia, e que esta minha administração, que em Jerusalém faço, seja bem aceita pelos santos;
text_el: ἵνα ῥυσθῶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀπειθούντων ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ καὶ ἡ διακονία μου ἡ εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ εὐπρόσδεκτος τοῖς ἁγίοις γένηται,

text_en: That I may come to you with joy , by the will of God , and may be refreshed with you.
text_la: ut veniam ad vos in gaudio per voluntatem Dei, et refrigerer vobiscum.
text_pt: A fim de que, pela vontade de Deus, chegue a vós com alegria, e possa recrear-me convosco.
text_el: ἵνα ἐν χαρᾷ ἐλθὼν πρὸς ὑμᾶς διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ συναναπαύσωμαι ὑμῖν.

text_en: Now the God of peace be with, you all. Amen .
text_la: Deus autem pacis sit cum omnibus vobis. Amen.
text_pt: E o Deus de paz seja com todos vós. Amém.
text_el: ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν: ἀμήν.

text_en: And I commend to you Phebe, our sister, who is in the ministry of the church, that is in Cenchrae:
text_la: Commendo autem vobis Phœben sororem nostram, quæ est in ministerio ecclesiæ, quæ est in Cenchris:
text_pt: Recomendo-vos, pois, Febe, nossa irmã, a qual serve na igreja que está em Cencréia,
text_el: Συνίστημι δὲ ὑμῖν Φοίβην τὴν ἀδελφὴν ἡμῶν, οὖσαν καὶ διάκονον τῆς ἐκκλησίας τῆς ἐν Κεγχρεαῖς,

text_en: That you receive her in the Lord as becomes saints and that you assist her in whatsoever business she shall have need of you. For she also has assisted many, and myself also.
text_la: ut eam suscipiatis in Domino digne sanctis : et assistatis ei in quocumque negotio vestri indiguerit : etenim ipsa quoque astitit multis, et mihi ipsi.
text_pt: Para que a recebais no Senhor, como convém aos santos, e a ajudeis em qualquer coisa que de vós necessitar; porque tem hospedado a muitos, como também a mim mesmo.
text_el: ἵνα προσδέξησθε αὐτὴν ἐν κυρίῳ ἀξίως τῶν ἁγίων, καὶ παραστῆτε αὐτῇ ἐν ᾧ ἂν ὑμῶν χρῄζῃ πράγματι, καὶ γὰρ αὐτὴ προστάτις πολλῶν ἐγενήθη καὶ ἐμοῦ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Salute Prisca and Aquila , my helpers, in Christ Jesus
text_la: Salutate Priscam et Aquilam, adjutores meos in Christo Jesu
text_pt: Saudai a Priscila e a Áqüila, meus cooperadores em Cristo Jesus,
text_el: Ἀσπάσασθε Πρίσκαν καὶ Ἀκύλαν τοὺς συνεργούς μου ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,

text_en: (who have for my life laid down their own necks: to whom not I only give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles ),
text_la: (qui pro anima mea suas cervices supposuerunt : quibus non solus ego gratias ago, sed et cunctæ ecclesiæ gentium),
text_pt: Os quais pela minha vida expuseram as suas cabeças; o que não só eu lhes agradeço, mas também todas as igrejas dos gentios.
text_el: οἵτινες ὑπὲρ τῆς ψυχῆς μου τὸν ἑαυτῶν τράχηλον ὑπέθηκαν, οἷς οὐκ ἐγὼ μόνος εὐχαριστῶ ἀλλὰ καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τῶν ἐθνῶν,

text_en: and the church which is in their house. Salute Epenetus, my beloved: who is the firstfruits of Asia in Christ .
text_la: et domesticam ecclesiam eorum. Salutate Epænetum dilectum mihi, qui est primitivus Asiæ in Christo.
text_pt: Saudai também a igreja que está em sua casa. Saudai a Epêneto, meu amado, que é as primícias da Acáia em Cristo.
text_el: καὶ τὴν κατ' οἶκον αὐτῶν ἐκκλησίαν. ἀσπάσασθε Ἐπαίνετον τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου, ὅς ἐστιν ἀπαρχὴ τῆς Ἀσίας εἰς Χριστόν.

text_en: Salute Mary , who has laboured much among you.
text_la: Salutate Mariam, quæ multum laboravit in vobis.
text_pt: Saudai a Maria, que trabalhou muito por nós.
text_el: ἀσπάσασθε Μαρίαν, ἥτις πολλὰ ἐκοπίασεν εἰς ὑμᾶς.

text_en: Salute Andronicus and Junias, my kinsmen and fellow prisoners: who are of note among the apostles , who also were in Christ before me.
text_la: Salutate Andronicum et Juniam, cognatos, et concaptivos meos : qui sunt nobiles in Apostolis, qui et ante me fuerunt in Christo.
text_pt: Saudai a Andrônico e a Júnias, meus parentes e meus companheiros na prisão, os quais se distinguiram entre os apóstolos e que foram antes de mim em Cristo.
text_el: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀνδρόνικον καὶ Ἰουνιᾶν τοὺς συγγενεῖς μου καὶ συναιχμαλώτους μου, οἵτινές εἰσιν ἐπίσημοι ἐν τοῖς ἀποστόλοις, οἳ καὶ πρὸ ἐμοῦ γέγοναν ἐν Χριστῷ.

text_en: Salute Ampliatus, most beloved to me in the Lord .
text_la: Salutate Ampliatum dilectissimum mihi in Domino.
text_pt: Saudai a Amplias, meu amado no Senhor.
text_el: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀμπλιᾶτον τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου ἐν κυρίῳ.

text_en: Salute Urbanus, our helper in Christ Jesus and Stachys, my beloved.
text_la: Salutate Urbanum adjutorem nostrum in Christo Jesu, et Stachyn dilectum meum.
text_pt: Saudai a Urbano, nosso cooperador em Cristo, e a Estáquis, meu amado.
text_el: ἀσπάσασθε Οὐρβανὸν τὸν συνεργὸν ἡμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ καὶ Στάχυν τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου.

text_en: Salute Apellas, approved in Christ .
text_la: Salutate Apellen probum in Christo.
text_pt: Saudai a Apeles, aprovado em Cristo. Saudai aos da família de Aristóbulo.
text_el: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀπελλῆν τὸν δόκιμον ἐν Χριστῷ. ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐκ τῶν Ἀριστοβούλου.

text_en: Salute them that are of Aristobulus' household. Salute Herodian, my kinsman. Salute them that are of Narcissus' household, who are in the Lord .
text_la: Salutate eos qui sunt ex Aristoboli domo. Salutate Herodionem cognatum meum. Salutate eos qui sunt ex Narcisi domo, qui sunt in Domino.
text_pt: Saudai a Herodião, meu parente. Saudai aos da família de Narciso, os que estão no Senhor.
text_el: ἀσπάσασθε Ἡρῳδίωνα τὸν συγγενῆ μου. ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐκ τῶν Ναρκίσσου τοὺς ὄντας ἐν κυρίῳ.

text_en: Salute Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord . Salute Persis, the dearly beloved, who has much laboured in the Lord .
text_la: Salutate Tryphænam et Tryphosam, quæ laborant in Domino. Salutate Persidem carissimam, quæ multum laboravit in Domino.
text_pt: Saudai a Trifena e a Trifosa, as quais trabalham no Senhor. Saudai à amada Pérside, a qual muito trabalhou no Senhor.
text_el: ἀσπάσασθε Τρύφαιναν καὶ Τρυφῶσαν τὰς κοπιώσας ἐν κυρίῳ. ἀσπάσασθε Περσίδα τὴν ἀγαπητήν, ἥτις πολλὰ ἐκοπίασεν ἐν κυρίῳ.

text_en: Salute Rufus , elect in the Lord , and his mother and mine.
text_la: Salutate Rufum electum in Domino, et matrem ejus, et meam.
text_pt: Saudai a Rufo, eleito no Senhor, e a sua mãe e minha.
text_el: ἀσπάσασθε Ῥοῦφον τὸν ἐκλεκτὸν ἐν κυρίῳ καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐμοῦ.

text_en: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes : and the brethren that are with them.
text_la: Salutate Asyncritum, Phlegontem, Hermam, Patrobam, Hermen, et qui cum eis sunt, fratres.
text_pt: Saudai a Asíncrito, a Flegonte, a Hermes, a Pátrobas, a Hermas, e aos irmãos que estão com eles.
text_el: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀσύγκριτον, Φλέγοντα, Ἑρμῆν, Πατροβᾶν, Ἑρμᾶν, καὶ τοὺς σὺν αὐτοῖς ἀδελφούς.

text_en: Salute Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympias: and all the saints that are with them.
text_la: Salutate Philologum et Juliam, Nereum, et sororem ejus, et Olympiadem, et omnes qui cum eis sunt, sanctos.
text_pt: Saudai a Filólogo e a Júlia, a Nereu e a sua irmã, e a Olimpas, e a todos os santos que com eles estão.
text_el: ἀσπάσασθε Φιλόλογον καὶ Ἰουλίαν, Νηρέα καὶ τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτοῦ, καὶ Ὀλυμπᾶν, καὶ τοὺς σὺν αὐτοῖς πάντας ἁγίους.

text_en: Salute one another with an holy kiss . All the churches of Christ salute you.
text_la: Salutate invicem in osculo sancto. Salutant vos omnes ecclesiæ Christi.
text_pt: Saudai-vos uns aos outros com santo ósculo. As igrejas de Cristo vos saúdam.
text_el: ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἁγίῳ. ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς αἱ ἐκκλησίαι πᾶσαι τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

text_en: Now I beseech you, brethren, to mark them who make dissensions and offences contrary to the doctrine which you have learned and avoid them.
text_la: Rogo autem vos fratres, ut observetis eos qui dissensiones et offendicula, præter doctrinam, quam vos didicistis, faciunt, et declinate ab illis.
text_pt: E rogo-vos, irmãos, que noteis os que promovem dissensões e escândalos contra a doutrina que aprendestes; desviai-vos deles.
text_el: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, σκοπεῖν τοὺς τὰς διχοστασίας καὶ τὰ σκάνδαλα παρὰ τὴν διδαχὴν ἣν ὑμεῖς ἐμάθετε ποιοῦντας, καὶ ἐκκλίνετε ἀπ' αὐτῶν:

text_en: For they that are such serve not Christ our Lord but their own belly: and by pleasing speeches and good words seduce the hearts of the innocent.
text_la: Hujuscemodi enim Christo Domino nostro non serviunt, sed suo ventri : et per dulces sermones et benedictiones seducunt corda innocentium.
text_pt: Porque os tais não servem a nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, mas ao seu ventre; e com suaves palavras e lisonjas enganam os corações dos simples.
text_el: οἱ γὰρ τοιοῦτοι τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν Χριστῷ οὐ δουλεύουσιν ἀλλὰ τῇ ἑαυτῶν κοιλίᾳ, καὶ διὰ τῆς χρηστολογίας καὶ εὐλογίας ἐξαπατῶσιν τὰς καρδίας τῶν ἀκάκων.

text_en: For your obedience is published in every place. I rejoice therefore in you. But I would have you to be wise in good and simple in evil .
text_la: Vestra enim obedientia in omnem locum divulgata est. Gaudeo igitur in vobis. Sed volo vos sapientes esse in bono, et simplices in malo.
text_pt: Quanto à vossa obediência, é ela conhecida de todos. Comprazo-me, pois, em vós; e quero que sejais sábios no bem, mas simples no mal.
text_el: ἡ γὰρ ὑμῶν ὑπακοὴ εἰς πάντας ἀφίκετο: ἐφ' ὑμῖν οὖν χαίρω, θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς σοφοὺς [μὲν] εἶναι εἰς τὸ ἀγαθόν, ἀκεραίους δὲ εἰς τὸ κακόν.

text_en: And the God of peace crush Satan under your feet speedily. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
text_la: Deus autem pacis conterat Satanam sub pedibus vestris velociter. Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi vobiscum.
text_pt: E o Deus de paz esmagará em breve Satanás debaixo dos vossos pés. A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja convosco. Amém.
text_el: ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης συντρίψει τὸν Σατανᾶν ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας ὑμῶν ἐν τάχει. Ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ μεθ' ὑμῶν.

text_en: Timothy, my fellow labourer, salutes you: and Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my kinsmen.
text_la: Salutat vos Timotheus adjutor meus, et Lucius, et Jason, et Sosipater cognati mei.
text_pt: Saúdam-vos Timóteo, meu cooperador, e Lúcio, Jasom e Sosípatro, meus parentes.
text_el: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Τιμόθεος ὁ συνεργός [μου], καὶ Λούκιος καὶ Ἰάσων καὶ Σωσίπατρος οἱ συγγενεῖς μου.

text_en: I, Tertius, who wrote this epistle , salute you in the Lord .
text_la: Saluto vos ego Tertius, qui scripsi epistolam, in Domino.
text_pt: Eu, Tércio, que esta carta escrevi, vos saúdo no Senhor.
text_el: ἀσπάζομαι ὑμᾶς ἐγὼ Τέρτιος ὁ γράψας τὴν ἐπιστολὴν ἐν κυρίῳ.

text_en: Caius, my host, and the whole church salutes you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, salutes you: and Quartus, a brother.
text_la: Salutat vos Cajus hospes meus, et universa ecclesia. Salutat vos Erastus arcarius civitatis, et Quartus, frater.
text_pt: Saúda-vos Gaio, meu hospedeiro, e de toda a igreja. Saúda-vos Erasto, procurador da cidade, e também o irmão Quarto.
text_el: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Γάϊος ὁ ξένος μου καὶ ὅλης τῆς ἐκκλησίας. ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἔραστος ὁ οἰκονόμος τῆς πόλεως καὶ Κούαρτος ὁ ἀδελφός.

text_en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen .
text_la: Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi cum omnibus vobis. Amen.
text_pt: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com todos vós. Amém.

text_en: Now to him that is able to establish you, according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ , according to the revelation of the mystery which was kept secret from eternity ;
text_la: Ei autem, qui potens est vos confirmare juxta Evangelium meum, et prædicationem Jesu Christi, secundum revelationem mysterii temporibus æternis taciti
text_pt: Ora, àquele que é poderoso para vos confirmar segundo o meu evangelho e a pregação de Jesus Cristo, conforme a revelação do mistério que desde tempos eternos esteve oculto,
text_el: Τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ ὑμᾶς στηρίξαι κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιόν μου καὶ τὸ κήρυγμα Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν μυστηρίου χρόνοις αἰωνίοις σεσιγημένου

text_en: (which now is made manifest by the scriptures of the prophets , according to the precept of the eternal God , for the obedience of faith ) known among all nations:
text_la: (quod nunc patefactum est per Scripturas prophetarum secundum præceptum æterni Dei, ad obeditionem fidei), in cunctis gentibus cogniti,
text_pt: Mas que se manifestou agora, e se notificou pelas Escrituras dos profetas, segundo o mandamento do Deus eterno, a todas as nações para obediência da fé;
text_el: φανερωθέντος δὲ νῦν διά τε γραφῶν προφητικῶν κατ' ἐπιταγὴν τοῦ αἰωνίου θεοῦ εἰς ὑπακοὴν πίστεως εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη γνωρισθέντος,

text_en: To God , the only wise, through Jesus Christ , to whom be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen .
text_la: soli sapienti Deo, per Jesum Christum, cui honor et gloria in sæcula sæculorum. Amen.
text_pt: Ao único Deus, sábio, seja dada glória por Jesus Cristo para todo o sempre. Amém.
text_el: μόνῳ σοφῷ θεῷ, διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, [ᾧ] ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας: ἀμήν.
